subject: ACME Renewal & Expansion — Recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@acme.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-15T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: ACME Renewal & Expansion — Recap and next steps

Hi Jamie / Alex —

Thanks again for the 45m today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on scope and timeline. TL;DR: ACME is a good fit for Redwood Dedicated for your bursty batch workloads + continued hosted for chat/assist.

What we covered
- Current usage: ~1.2B tokens/month (chat + summarization), peak periods at ~18k QPS for short requests.
- Primary workloads: customer support assistant (real-time chat), weekly summarization jobs, and a new semantic search/embeddings pipeline you want to pilot.
- Pain points: intermittent latency spikes during peak windows (~300–400ms tail), unpredictable cost on hosted multi-tenant during heavy batch jobs, and concerns around KV cache misses for long conversations.
- Goals: stabilize latency (SLO target 95th <= 200ms), reduce per-token cost ~25% for batch jobs, and enable enterprise-grade auditability for the search pipeline.

Proposed expansion path
1) Trial Redwood Dedicated: 2x A10G-equivalent nodes for 6 weeks to measure tail latency and cost for your batch jobs.
2) Enable Redwood Optimize: batching/caching recommendations + quantization profile for the summarization workload.
3) Deploy embeddings pipeline on a reserved instance (pilot) and run an offline migration test.
4) If results meet targets, move to a 12-month reserved capacity commit with burst policy.

Deliverables & next steps
- I attached the ACME usage report and a short draft MoM from today.
- Rishi will prepare an initial Dedicated sizing and pricing estimate (deliverable: 2 business days).
- Stephanie will pull SOC2 evidence and package the common security artifacts for your procurement team (deliverable: 3 business days).
- Jamie / Alex: please confirm the procurement contact and whether you can commit to a pilot start the week of 7/27.

Estimated timeline
- Pilot kickoff: week of 7/27
- 6-week evaluation: through early September
- Decision window: by end of September (target: 9/30)

Open questions
- Will the embeddings pilot need a separate VPC?
- Any constraints on data residency / audit logs beyond SOC2?

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the Dedicated sizing and a brief procurement checklist.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachments: ACME-usage-report.xlsx (spreadsheet), draft_MoM.pdf (summary)

From: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme.com>
Date: 2026-07-16T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME Renewal & Expansion — Recap and next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap — this matches our notes. A few clarifications:
- Procurement: I’m looping in Alex (copied) as our procurement lead. He’ll own the contract/regulatory path.
- Timeline: the week of 7/27 is doable for a kickoff; we just need to ensure security artifacts are in place beforehand.
- Embeddings: yes, we’d prefer the embeddings pilot to sit in our VPC if possible — will that be supported for a pilot?

I’ll review the usage report this afternoon and flag any follow-ups. Please include a short one-page pilot scope so Alex can expedite approvals.

Thanks,
Jamie
Head of AI Platforms | Acme Corp
jamie.liu@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Liu <jamie.liu@acme.com>, Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@acme.com>

Subject: Re: ACME Renewal & Expansion — Recap and next steps

Great — thanks Jamie. Quick answers:
- VPC pilot: yes, we can run the embeddings pilot inside your VPC (we’ll coordinate networking). Stephanie, can you scope any extra steps for that?
- Pilot scope: attached is a one-page pilot scope (see draft_MoM.pdf). It calls out objectives, success metrics (latency <=200ms 95th, cost reduction target 25% on batch), and a 6-week timeline.
- Security artifacts: Stephanie will share SOC2 + audit log samples; we’ll package these in a single ZIP and send to Alex.

Next steps I’ll take now:
- Rishi: I’ll need the Dedicated sizing and a short price range today end-of-day so Alex can start internal approvals.
- I’ll also send a DocuSign link for a scoped pilot SOW once we lock sizing.

Marissa

Folks — quick internal note summarizing action items from the ACME call so we’re aligned before I reply to Alex.

1) Rishi — please prioritize a conservative Dedicated config: 2 x A10G-equivalent nodes, expected to handle the peak batch windows with headroom. Include estimated costs vs hosted and a 6-week pilot price. Need this by EOD 7/20.

2) Stephanie — package SOC2, data retention policy, audit log samples, and a short checklist for VPC onboarding. Acme asked for a single ZIP to hand to procurement; target delivery EOD 7/21.

3) Marissa (me) — I’ll prepare the pilot SOW and a one-page scoping doc and send DocuSign once sizing is approved. Also confirm the VPC network contact from Acme (Alex).

Notes: be ready to offer a limited promotional discount for the pilot if needed to secure a rapid start — I'll propose 10% pilot discount as negotiation buffer.

Thanks — I’ll wait on your updates and then share the consolidated package with Alex.

Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
